Use when cartoon / stickman character images come with a hook + body script. Phrases - EN - "stickman ad", "talking cartoon character"; UA - "стікмен", "мультяшний персонаж говорить".
---

# Stickman talking-head pipeline

Run everything from the `podcast/` folder of the project. Kaleido is the production environment: every generation costs
money, so state the cost before launching. Reply in the requester's language, briefly. Reference project:
`projects/stick_avoidant/` (script.txt, moods.json, secs_override.json, plan_<char>.json, clips/). Tools: `stick/plan.py`,
`stick/check.py`, `stick/lipcheck.py`, `stick/timeline.py`. Templates and numbers: `formats/stick_talking.json` (every rule
there has a `_why` key).

**Run log `stick/RUNLOG.md` - read it before a run, append one line after EVERY take** (job, secs/words, result,
cause -> rule). A failure without a named cause is not allowed; every review remark becomes a template / format / check
change in the same session. No blind retries: each take is paid for, so learn from each failure before the next launch.

## Quality bar
- **Face:** bright and expressive, energy in the eyes, brows, head and voice; the mouth only shapes the words. No constant
  grin (half-face smiles get rejected), not gloomy either. A light smile only on happy words or after the last word.
- **Brows:** lifted and softly arched the whole clip. "Confident excitement" slants men's brows down and reads as angry.
- **Movement:** moving all the time (too few moves looks stiff), but every move must fit the meaning - generic
  "storyteller" moves (winks, hand on hip, random swings) read as irrelevant. Per-character body lines live in
  `body_hook` / `body_short`. Never tie a gesture to a quoted phrase (closed-mouth acting, burned-in subtitles).
- **Pace:** lively; long pauses are noticed. Omni keeps ~0.65 s between sentences even when 0.3 s is asked.
- **Voice:** one voice per character across hook and body -> the body BASE uses the approved HOOK prompt with only the
  text (and the delivery line) replaced; extends use a shortened version of the same prompt. Child-looking characters
  get adult voices and an adult-character line.
- **Image quality:** no blur or compression artifacts. Extend works well with few iterations launched right the first time
  -> ONE chain per character with few long pieces (<= 10 s); check sharpness per extend.
- **Process:** a hook for every character first, approval, then the bodies. One take per launch.

## Hard limits found on the bodies (all logged in RUNLOG)
- **Omni refuses to extend a clip longer than 30 s** (`Videos longer than 30s are not supported for extension`) and the
  chain room floors to whole seconds. Plan pieces until the clip is <= 30 s (e.g. 9+8+7+5 = 29), then ONE last extend
  of <= 10 s. Put `|` seams in BODY so the last piece holds everything after ~29 s.
- **A fresh clip does NOT keep the voice**, even with the identical prompt (a separately generated ending sounds
  clearly different). Everything after the hook must stay in the one chain.
- **Pace is per character, measured on its OWN base** (boy 3.8, girl 3.3-3.6, expert 3.3 overall). Copying another
  character's durations cut the expert's last words twice. Omni stretches speech to fill the clip: too long = pauses /
  repeats ("built around built around"), too short = a cut last word. Choose the smallest duration that fits.
- **Looping sentences get their own piece:** "It showed me ... kept pushing them away" looped 4 times when paired; alone at
  7 s it passed on all three characters. Hotspot: "an app built around attachment styles" stumbles ~1 of 3 runs.
- **Prompt leak:** character / context lines right under the lipsync text were SPOKEN ("explaining my 30 ... dating
  style"). Extends carry no character line; the girl's moderation line goes at the end as "Not spoken, background only".
- **Sharpness** drops ~0.1 per extend; artifacts become visible around 0.41. Fail line 0.45; the 4th extend lands
  ~0.40-0.52 - flag it before accepting (voice continuity was preferred over sharpness).
- **Kaleido sometimes extends an older node** (boy e3 on e1): check `--expect`; use the new tail as its own segment.
- Low RAM (heavy audio / video apps open) crashes the QA: close them before a run.

## Steps
0. `whoami` -> "prod". Character images: copy to `projects/<id>/`, `create_upload_link` + `put_with` curl (FILE=...);
   the image URL is the upload's CDN address returned with the link. Image2video takes no aspect_ratio.
1. `projects/<id>/script.txt` (`HOOK:` / `BODY:` verbatim) and `moods.json` (one tone per body piece by MEANING; keys
   base, e1, e2... in piece order; the problem part self-ironic, never sad; a smile only in the happy part).
   `python stick/plan.py projects/<id>/script.txt --char boy|girl|expert` -> pieces, secs, prompts, cost.
   Sizing: secs = words / art_wps (articulation rate measured on approved hooks, ~4.2) + 0.65 s per sentence break +
   0.6 s lead/tail + 0.5 s join for an extend; seams on sentence ends; base/extends <= 10 s; a piece that already failed
   tight at N s goes into `secs_override.json` with the RUNLOG reason.
2. **Hooks** (all characters in parallel): `generate_videos` omni 720p, image_url, plan hook secs + prompt.
3. **Moderation:** ~60 s after every launch call `get_video_generation_job` once (blocks arrive at 25-50 s; check.py only
   sees the CDN). Blocked = free: fix the cause (adult-character line, context line, voice line in extends), relaunch.
4. **Check every take:** `python stick/check.py <id> <job> <name> --text "<words>" [--from <parent len> --parent <prev>
   --expect <parent len + secs>]` -> words (whisper + verbatim wav2vec2), lipsync, parent untouched, length, sharpness
   (fail < 0.5 of the chain base). Then READ `<name>_sheet.jpg` AND `<name>_faces.jpg` (brows, grins, odd moves, text).
   Stop a check only by its own PID (a wildcard kill takes down parallel checks too).
5. **Body** (after hook approval): base = `generate_videos` with the plan base prompt; each next piece =
   `generate_video_extension` on the newest PASSING job with the plan extend prompt + secs.
6. **Timeline:** segments json (hook 0..len, then the chain) -> `python stick/timeline.py <id> <id>_<char> segs.json
   script.txt` -> only `TIMELINE PASS`. With the local editor running on port 8765, open the printed URL; the final export
   is done from the editor.

## FAIL -> cause -> fix
| check says | cause | fix |
|---|---|---|
| last word cut / stutter | piece too tight for this speaker | +1 s via secs_override (log it) |
| repeated phrase | piece too loose | -1 s |
| voice with a still mouth | gesture tied to a phrase | generic body line only |
| letters on the sheet | quoted phrases / digits in the prompt | quotes only inside lipsync, numbers as words |
| parent re-rendered / zoom | Omni re-rendered the last ~10 s | relaunch from the same parent |
| length != expected | extend built on an older chain node | use its new tail as its own segment |
| sharpness < 0.5 | blur accumulated over extends | fresh base from the image at a sentence seam (invisible cut) |
| moderation | child-looking figure + relationship words | adult + context + voice lines are in every template |
| qa crash mkl_malloc / LLVM | low RAM | check.py uses whisper small; retry / POD_WHISPER_MODEL=base |

Spend reference: hook 5 s = USD 0.50, body ~38 s = USD 3.80 per character when every take passes.
